oil.when: 2024 gas models (oil change reminder reset on the infotainment touchscreen)
steps: Reset only after the engine oil and filter have actually been changed.
Park the car and switch it on so the infotainment touchscreen is running.
On the touchscreen, go to Setup, then Vehicle, then Convenience, then Oil Change Reminder, and choose Reset.
When the screen asks whether the engine oil has been changed, choose Yes to reset the oil life.
Check that the oil life now reads full. If no oil change alert ever appears by the maximum interval in the maintenance schedule, have the car checked by a dealer.
oil.note: Checked in the 2024 gas model's owner's manual.

tpms.when: 2024 (sensors in each wheel; no reset button)
steps: Set all four tires to the cold pressure on the label on the driver's door pillar, checking them before driving or after the car has sat a few hours.
There is no reset button or menu for the tire pressure light: the sensors in the wheels report the new pressures by themselves.
Drive the car normally. The low tire pressure light should go out within a few minutes of driving once the pressures are correct.
If the light stays on after a few minutes of driving, recheck all four pressures; if they are right, have a Hyundai dealer check the tires and sensors.
tpms.note: If the tire pressure light blinks for about one minute and then stays on, the monitoring system has a fault (or a spare without a sensor is fitted). Setting the pressures will not clear it, so have it checked. Cold weather can lower pressures enough to turn the light on.
